# ui::ThemeColor

Header: `winui/ui/Paint.hpp`.

A color read from the theme each time it is used: a theme-resource brush. A captureless lambda taking a [`const Theme&`](../themes/theme.md) converts to it, and ui::theme_colors names one for every color of [ThemeColors](../themes/theme-colors.md). [with_alpha()](#with_alpha) gives the same color at another opacity.

It holds a plain function, so the resource is stateless. It follows an element's requested theme and theme switches without any subscription.

Example: 
```cpp
auto grid = std::make_unique<ui::GridControl>();
grid->set_background([](const ui::Theme& t) { return t.colors().background; });
ui::Border{.background = ui::theme_colors::Accent.with_alpha(0.7f)};
```

## Read

```cpp
using ui::ThemeColor::Read = Color (*)(const Theme&)
```

The function a resource reads its color with.

## ThemeColor

```cpp
template <typename F>
constexpr ThemeColor(F read) noexcept
    requires std::convertible_to<F, Read> && (!std::same_as<std::remove_cvref_t<F>, std::nullptr_t>)
```

The color `read` gives under a theme; a captureless lambda converts too.

## with_alpha

```cpp
ThemeColor with_alpha(float alpha) const noexcept
```

The same color with its alpha replaced by `alpha` (0..1), as [Color::with_alpha()](../core/color.md#with_alpha) does.

The color under `theme`. The resource must be set.
